checks: Working notes open immediately in a nonmodal right panel; label-only edits preserve metadata, dirty notes survive switching and Close, and Save updates only their card.
Hover shows a short contextual nonmodal menu without stealing focus, selection or storage; pointer travel works and outside/Escape dismiss safely.
The first contextual choice opens an unsaved suitable child beneath its own card; saving preserves frameworks, while the separate chevron only collapses or expands.
Keyboard plus, arrows and Enter choose an option; A remains quick add, and another card cannot steal an unsaved draft or change its parent.
The branch chooser is anchored and nonmodal; Escape returns focus and outside dismissal writes nothing.
One click applies a type to the selected branch, closes the chooser and preserves deeper overrides.
A delayed type save pauses selection and editing; after it finishes, fresh wording saves with working notes preserved.
An agent edit to the same card preserves unsaved human notes and blocks stale saves; a deliberate fresh edit merges with unrelated agent changes.
Standalone export keeps direct editing and the complete state without changing the live session.
The direct controls and short chooser work at 390px without script errors.
Solution menus add qualitative Driver cards; A adds a proposed solution, Undo preserves the tree, exploration suggests Solution, and numerical Driver subtrees still add metrics.
